SUMMERSUMMER

The fill must be a real image or a drawn pattern, never a two-colour gradient (that is the gradient-text tell). Keep a solid fallback colour for print and forced colours.
Signature
One heavy word used as a window: its letters are filled with a code-drawn stripe-and-sun pattern (or a real photograph), so the type becomes the picture of the page.
Use when
Event posters, seasonal campaigns, travel and food brands, social cards, record covers.
Turns into slop when
When the fill is a purple-to-pink gradient, when two words are masked, or when the masked word carries information people must read (it loses contrast).
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
